{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {df.duplicated(subset="patient_id").sum()}')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f'Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()}')

# Check assay_batch units: batch B is in µg/L, so divide by 10 to convert to ng/mL
print(f'Unique assay_batch values: {df["assay_batch"].unique()}')

# Check if sample_seq is > 1 for any patient
print(f'Patients with multiple sample_seq: {df[df.duplicated(subset="patient_id", keep=False)].shape[0]}')

# Check initial distribution of arms and sex
print(f'Initial arm distribution:
{df["arm"].value_counts()}
')
print(f'Initial sex distribution:
{df["sex"].value_counts()}
')

# Check severity distribution by sex and arm
print(f'Severity by sex:
{df.groupby("sex")["severity"].value_counts()}
')
print(f'Severity by arm:
{df.groupby("arm")["severity"].value_counts()}
')

# Save raw counts for later comparison
raw_arm_count = df["arm"].value_counts().to_dict()
raw_sex_count = df["sex"].value_counts().to_dict()"}
